entities.name: Yotia
entities.description: The most southern of the coastal kingdoms and chief military might of eastern Terisiare at the time of the Brothers' War; a monarchy whose capital was Kroog.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane on which Yotia lies.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: War that stripped Yotia's fields barren.

entities.name: Kroog
entities.description: Capital city of Yotia, which fell to Mishra's dragon engines.

entities.name: Fall of Kroog
entities.description: Fall of Yotia's capital to Mishra's dragon engines.

entities.name: Kayla bin-Kroog
entities.description: Daughter of the Warlord of Kroog and wife of Urza; became Queen of Kroog and later queen-in-exile.

entities.name: Tawnos
entities.description: Apprentice to Urza from the Yotian city of Jorilin.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Artificer whose side the Yotians fought on.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Whose dragon engines destroyed Kroog and whose Scorched Earth policy scarred Yotia.

entities.name: Warlord of Kroog
entities.description: Kayla's father, ruler of Yotia, who died at Korlinda.

entities.name: Fallaji
entities.description: Nomads who raided and occupied Yotia for ten years.

entities.name: Qadir
entities.description: Fallaji leader who met the Warlord at the Peace Summit at Korlinda.

entities.name: Korlinda
entities.description: Site of the failed Peace Summit where the Warlord died.

entities.name: Sword Marches
entities.description: Conquered territory in the west of Yotia, reduced to blackened glass by 55 AR.

entities.name: Hench
entities.description: Caravan town east of Kroog used as a refugee point and where the army regrouped.

entities.name: Jorilin
entities.description: Coastal Yotian city, hometown of Tawnos.

entities.name: Argive
entities.description: Nation formed by seafarers; it liberated Yotia and later absorbed it.

entities.name: Korlis
entities.description: Nation that helped liberate Yotia.

entities.name: New Yotia
entities.description: City that rose on the banks of the Mardun after the war, carrying on Yotian traditions.

entities.name: Penregon
entities.description: Argive capital where Kayla ruled in exile.

events.summary: The Peace Summit at Korlinda fails because both countries claim the Sword Marches; the Warlord dies there.
events.quote: which failed spectacularly because both countries claimed the Sword Marches as their own

events.summary: Kayla becomes Queen of Kroog, refusing the title Warlady.
events.quote: Kayla became the Queen of Kroog and refused the traditional title of "Warlady"

events.summary: Kroog falls to Mishra's dragon engines; the army regroups at Hench.

events.summary: Yotia remains under Fallaji occupation for ten years before liberation by Argive and Korlis.
events.quote: Yotia would remain under Fallaji occupation for ten years

events.summary: After the war New Yotia rises on the Mardun; the kingdom is later absorbed into Argive.
